parameters.text:
=You are a technical recruiter. Evaluate the candidate resume against the job description and return your assessment as structured JSON.

=== JOB DESCRIPTION ===
{{ $json.jd_text }}

=== CANDIDATE RESUME ===
{{ $json.text }}

Rules:
- Extract candidate_name and email (empty string if no email).
- Give score 0-100 for JD match.
- tier is exactly one of: "Strong Fit", "Possible Fit", "Not Fit".
- List matched_skills and missing_skills against the JD.
- reasoning must cite exactly what matched or is missing.
- recommendation is a short next step for the recruiter.

parameters.content:
## AI Resume Screening & Interview Scheduling Copilot
POST multipart/form-data to /webhook/resume-screening with one or more PDF resumes, `job_description`, `recruiter_name`, and `recruiter_email`. Returns one JSON payload with per-candidate results.
Validates the request (JD + at least one PDF) and splits every uploaded resume into its own item. Invalid requests get a 400 JSON response.
Gemini scores each resume vs the JD and returns strict structured JSON (name, email, score, tier, skills, rationale, recommendation).

Every candidate is logged to Google Sheets with a per-tier status (Invited / Review Required / Rejected). Strong Fits also get an interview email + Google Calendar event with a Meet link. Results are aggregated into one response.
